properties.CQL Statement: INSERT INTO nifi_test.cicd_scratch (item_id, name, quantity, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, toTimestamp(now()))
SELECT item_id, name, quantity FROM nifi_test.cicd_scratch WHERE item_id = ?
UPDATE nifi_test.cicd_scratch SET quantity = ?, updated_at = toTimestamp(now()) WHERE item_id = ? IF EXISTS
SELECT chat_id, count(*) AS messages, min(sent_at) AS first_message_at, max(sent_at) AS last_message_at FROM nifi_test.messages_by_chat GROUP BY chat_id
SELECT msg_date, count(*) AS messages FROM nifi_test.messages_by_chat WHERE chat_id = ? GROUP BY msg_date
